_comment: A lone block of 140 Spearmen (9 files of 16, close order, 9 wu pitch) facing south at x 1090, its left flank 24 wu short of the field's hill (Battle.TERRAIN's block patch from x 1150), doubled to 18 files of 8 by a plain explicatio (B). The wing that opens toward the hill runs its outer files hard onto the rock. The men the rock holds off their places stand while their steps make no way, the men behind them stand on them, and once every man has taken his place or stands the drill ends, between ticks 810 and 820 (explicatio_following, the men still following: 124 at tick 32, 22 at tick 800, null at tick 820). On main it never ends. This clip shows a regression of the drill now ending, which waits on relational formation keeping (#1954, #1990): once the slot grid is laid, the slots of the 22 men short lie on the rock, they press on for them, and the block walks back after them, its front from y 537.5 when the drill ends to 511.5 at tick 1040, about 220 ticks after, while the men at the face crowd to 1.02 wu apart. The overlap and follow_error verdicts are exempted for that, with the values measured on seed runs 0 to 4, which play out identically; the expects pin the end and the walk back so a change to either shows. The x 1075 clip (explicatio-held-by-terrain-1967) stands back far enough that it does not happen. Measured 2026-11-15 on FULL dumps every 10 ticks from tick 700 to 1200. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
